_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): a complete recipe for a greenfield project. NOT new code — it composes existing L3/L4 templates, pre-connected into one working project. One call = full backend.
name: stack-webapp
description: Complete FastAPI backend: project-fastapi + feature-errors + feature-auth + feature-crud + security gate (CI included) + docker-compose + nginx. One call = full greenfield backend.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'demo_api' (drives all nested packages)

notes: Greenfield starter. IMPORTANT: feature_name must NOT be 'User' — the auth feature already owns models/user.py (use 'Product', 'Order', 'Invoice', ...). After applying: set the app title in {{ project_name }}/config.py, add real model fields, register the routers (auth + {{ feature_name|lower }}) in {{ project_name }}/main.py, put JWT_SECRET in .env. CI, security gate, docker and nginx come pre-configured.
